clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Skinning is an introductory wilderness quest directing skinners in Orgrimmar to Thuwd to learn how to craft a Camp Chair. By putting harvested hides to use for field comfort, adventurers can establish proper campsites out in the wilds of Kalimdor.

Harvesting the pelts and hides of fallen beasts is one of the most practical survival skills an adventurer can cultivate in the wild. While raw leathers usually feed armorcraft, skilled skinners can also turn their harvested pelts into field comforts. In Orgrimmar, instructors direct capable skinners to Thuwd to learn the craft of assembling a sturdy Camp Chair from cured hides.

Townsfolk and guards frown upon travelers pitching temporary camps along busy city thoroughfares. As Thuwd reminds new craftsmen, a camp chair is meant for open territory away from settlement walls. Furthermore, no wilderness camp is complete with seating alone; a proper site requires a warm campfire, a basic technique taught by cooks across Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
